rows.t: So the old prophecy comes home — Telemus foretold I would lose my sight at the hands of Odysseus, and I watched all these years for a great man, not this little worthless nothing who undid me with wine. Hear me, Poseidon, dark-haired shaker of the earth, if I am truly your son: grant that Odysseus, sacker of cities, never reach his home. Or if he must, let him come late and broken, on a stranger's ship, all his comrades lost — and find trouble waiting in his house.

OD-B09-S01 · Odysseus Names Himself.title: Odysseus Names Himself
beats: Odysseus praises Demodocus and the ordered feast.
He finally declares his name, lineage, and Ithacan homeland.
He describes Ithaca's rugged beauty and his longing to return.
He begins the account of the disasters that followed Troy.
OD-B09-S01 · Odysseus Names Himself.exitState: He begins the account of the disasters that followed Troy.

OD-B09-S02 · The Raid on the Cicones.title: The Raid on the Cicones
beats: Odysseus's fleet sacks Ismarus and divides the captured wealth.
He orders immediate departure, but the crews remain to feast.
Cicones from inland arrive in organized force and fight through the day.
Six men from every ship are killed before the fleet escapes at dusk.
OD-B09-S02 · The Raid on the Cicones.exitState: Six men from every ship are killed before the fleet escapes at dusk.

OD-B09-S03 · The Lotus-Eaters.title: The Lotus-Eaters
beats: A north wind drives the ships off course for nine days.
They land among the Lotus-eaters and send three scouts inland.
The inhabitants offer lotus; those who taste it lose all desire for home.
Odysseus drags the weeping men back, binds them under the benches, and departs.
OD-B09-S03 · The Lotus-Eaters.exitState: Odysseus drags the weeping men back and orders immediate departure.

OD-B09-S04 · Goat Island and the Cyclops.title: Goat Island and the Cyclops Coast
beats: The fleet reaches a fertile, unworked island opposite the Cyclopes' land.
In darkness the ships enter a sheltered harbor and rest.
At dawn the crews hunt wild goats and feast, watching smoke across the channel.
Odysseus takes one ship and selects twelve men to investigate the neighboring people.
OD-B09-S04 · Goat Island and the Cyclops.exitState: Odysseus takes one ship and selects twelve men to investigate the neighboring people.

OD-B09-S05 · The Empty Cave.title: The Empty Cave
beats: Odysseus carries a skin of Maron's powerful wine and leads twelve men to a huge cave.
They find cheeses, pails, whey, lambs, and kids arranged by age.
The crew begs to steal food and animals and escape.
Odysseus refuses because he wants to meet the owner and receive a guest-gift.
OD-B09-S05 · The Empty Cave.exitState: Odysseus refuses because he wants to meet the owner and receive a guest-gift.

OD-B09-S06 · Polyphemus Seals the Cave.title: Polyphemus Seals the Cave
beats: At dusk Polyphemus returns carrying a massive load of wood and drives his flock inside.
He lifts a stone slab that no ordinary team could move and blocks the entrance.
He milks ewes and goats, sets young beneath mothers, curdles milk, and lights a fire.
The fire reveals the hidden men and the giant demands their identity.
OD-B09-S06 · Polyphemus Seals the Cave.exitState: The fire reveals the hidden men and the giant demands their identity.

OD-B09-S07 · The First Killings.title: The First Killings
beats: Odysseus claims they are survivors of Agamemnon's fleet and invokes Zeus's protection of strangers.
Polyphemus mocks the gods and demands to know where the ship is.
Odysseus lies that Poseidon smashed it against the rocks.
The Cyclops seizes two men, smashes them on the floor, and devours them raw.
He drinks milk and sleeps among his animals while the survivors pray in horror.
OD-B09-S07 · The First Killings.exitState: He drinks milk and sleeps among his animals while the survivors pray in horror.

OD-B09-S08 · The Name Nobody and the Sta.title: The Name Nobody and the Stake
beats: Odysseus considers killing the sleeping giant but realizes the sealing stone would trap the men forever.
At dawn Polyphemus eats two more men and drives the flock out, sealing the cave behind him.
Odysseus cuts and smooths an olive trunk into a stake and hardens its point in the fire.
The men hide the stake and draw lots for the four who will help wield it.
When the giant returns, Odysseus offers the potent wine and gives his name as Nobody.
OD-B09-S08 · The Name Nobody and the Sta.exitState: Odysseus offers the potent wine and says his name is Nobody.

OD-B09-S09 · The Blinding.title: The Blinding
beats: Polyphemus drinks three bowls, promises Nobody the last death, and collapses.
Odysseus heats the stake until it glows and the men drive it into the Cyclops's eye.
They twist it as blood and steam erupt; Polyphemus wakes with a roar and tears it free.
Other Cyclopes call from outside but leave when he says Nobody is killing him.
Polyphemus gropes at the entrance while the men hide among the animals.
OD-B09-S09 · The Blinding.exitState: Polyphemus gropes at the entrance while the men hide among the animals.

OD-B09-S10 · Escape beneath the Rams.title: Escape beneath the Rams
beats: At dawn Polyphemus opens the cave and feels every animal's back as it passes.
Odysseus binds three rams abreast for each man, suspending a sailor beneath the middle animal.
He clings beneath the great lead ram while Polyphemus speaks tenderly to it.
Outside, the men release themselves, drive the flock to the ship, and row away.
They divide the animals and sacrifice the great ram to Zeus.
OD-B09-S10 · Escape beneath the Rams.exitState: They divide the animals and sacrifice the great ram to Zeus.

OD-B09-S11 · The Boast and the Curse.title: The Boast and the Curse
beats: From offshore Odysseus taunts the blinded Cyclops despite his men's pleas.
Polyphemus tears off a mountain peak and hurls it, driving a wave that nearly beaches the ship.
Odysseus rows farther out, then reveals his true name and lineage.
Polyphemus recalls a prophecy, calls on Poseidon, and asks that Odysseus return late, alone, in pain.
A second rock misses as the ship escapes to the fleet.
OD-B09-S11 · The Boast and the Curse.exitState: A second rock misses as the ship escapes to the fleet.
